Using symmetry and the uniform noise/prior, E[common value | my signal=24 and I am highest] ≈ 23.82. In a second-price auction bidding that conditional expectation is near-optimal. I therefore shade my bid slightly below my signal to avoid the winner’s curse while remaining competitive.]
